jobs.title: Head of Sourcing, General Services
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Head of Sourcing, General Services to lead strategic sourcing and category management actvities covering, Professional Services, Travel, HR, Marketing and Digital and IT-related spend categories. Leading a team of 4, the role is responsible for developing and implementing category strategies, managing complex sourcing initiatives, driving cost optimization, and building strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You, along with your team, will play a key role in delivering measurable business value through effective category and supplier relationship management. The successful candidate will combine strong procurement expertise with a hands-on approach, thriving in a dynamic environment where collaboration, influence and execution are critical to success.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Own and manage procurement across the General Services categories with accountability for category performance and results.

• Analyze spend and identify opportunities to drive savings, value creation, and process improvements.

• Define and implement sourcing strategies for procurement initiatives across global, regional, or complex scopes.

• Lead strategic sourcing projects from market analysis through supplier selection, contracting, and implementation.

• Conduct market research, RFx processes, tender evaluations, and supplier negotiations.

• Negotiate commercial and contractual terms in partnership with Legal and key business stakeholders.

• Manage highly complex procurement projects and strategic initiatives while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Lead, coach, and develop team members, setting clear objectives and supporting performance and growth.

• Partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Digital, HR, Legal, Marketing, Customer Service, and other business functions.

• Manage supplier relationships, including performance reviews, commercial discussions, contract renewals, escalations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Monitor market trends, innovations, and emerging solutions to identify opportunities that improve quality, sustainability, cost efficiency, and total cost of ownership.

• Oversee contract implementation and ensure successful adoption across the business.

• Contribute to achieving key procurement objectives including savings, category maturity, supplier optimization, and working capital improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement and strategic transformation within procurement processes and ways of working.

About You

• University degree or equivalent qualification.

• 7-8+ years of category management and strategic sourcing experience in an international environment.

• Proven experience managing Digital and/or IT procurement and / or other relevant General Services category

• Previous people leadership experience, including coaching and developing teams.

• Strong negotiation skills with a track record of delivering commercial value.

• Highly analytical with strong attention to detail and the ability to perform complex spend and sourcing analyses.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple functions and seniority levels.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced, and evolving business environments.

• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Collaborative team player with active listening skills, empathy, and a partnership mindset.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Capo di Sourcing, Servizi Generali per condurre attività strategiche di approvvigionamento e di gestione delle categorie, Servizi Professionali, Viaggi, HR, Marketing e Digitale e IT-correlato categorie di spesa. Leader di un team di 4, il ruolo è responsabile per lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di strategie di categoria, la gestione di complesse iniziative di approvvigionamento, l'ottimizzazione dei costi di guida e la costruzione di partnership forti con gli stakeholder interni e fornitori esterni. Lei, insieme al suo team, svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella fornitura di valore commerciale misurabile attraverso la gestione efficace delle relazioni di categoria e dei fornitori. Il candidato di successo unirà forti competenze di approvvigionamento con un approccio pratico, prosperando in un ambiente dinamico in cui la collaborazione, l'influenza e l'esecuzione sono fondamentali per il successo.

Responsabilità chiave

• Possedere e gestire gli appalti nelle categorie Servizi Generali con responsabilità per le prestazioni e i risultati di categoria.

• Analizzare spendere e identificare le opportunità per guidare il risparmio, la creazione di valore e i miglioramenti del processo.

• Definire e implementare strategie di approvvigionamento per iniziative in ambito globale, regionale o complesso.

• Condurre progetti di approvvigionamento strategico dall'analisi del mercato attraverso la selezione dei fornitori, la contrazione e l'implementazione.

• Condurre ricerche di mercato, processi RFx, valutazioni tenere e trattative di fornitori.

• Negoziare termini commerciali e contrattuali in collaborazione con gli stakeholder legali e chiave del business.

• Gestisci progetti di approvvigionamento altamente complessi e iniziative strategiche garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Guidare, allenare e sviluppare membri del team, stabilire obiettivi chiari e sostenere le prestazioni e la crescita.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interfunzionali tra cui Digital, HR, Legale, Marketing, Servizio Clienti e altre funzioni aziendali.

• Gestisci i rapporti dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni sulle prestazioni, le discussioni commerciali, i rinnovi contrattuali, le escalation e le iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, le innovazioni e le soluzioni emergenti per identificare le opportunità che migliorano la qualità, la sostenibilità, l'efficienza dei costi e il costo totale della proprietà.

• Controllare l'implementazione del contratto e garantire l'adozione di successo in tutto il business.

• Contribuire a raggiungere obiettivi chiave di approvvigionamento, tra cui risparmio, maturità di categoria, ottimizzazione dei fornitori e miglioramenti dei capitali di lavoro.

• Guidare il miglioramento continuo e la trasformazione strategica all'interno dei processi di approvvigionamento e dei modi di lavoro.

A proposito di te

• Laurea o qualifica equivalente.

• 7-8+ anni di gestione della categoria e di esperienza di approvvigionamento strategico in un ambiente internazionale.

• Esperienza comprovata nella gestione degli appalti digitali e/o IT e/o di altre categorie di servizi generali pertinenti

• Esperienza di leadership delle persone precedenti, tra cui coaching e team di sviluppo.

• Forte capacità di negoziazione con un track record di fornire valore commerciale.

• Altamente analitico con forte attenzione ai dettagli e la capacità di eseguire analisi complesse di spesa e di approvvigionamento.

• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare in più funzioni e livelli di anzianità.

• Comodo funzionamento in ambienti aziendali ambigui, veloci e in evoluzione.

• Proattivo, pratico e orientato alla soluzione con un forte senso di proprietà e responsabilità.

• Giocatore di squadra collaborativo con competenze di ascolto attivo, empatia e una mentalità di partenariato.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Head of Sourcing, General Services, um strategische Sourcing- und Category-Management-Aktivitäten in den Kategorien Professional Services, Travel, HR, Marketing und Digital und IT-bezogene Ausgaben zu leiten. Sie spielen zusammen mit Ihrem Team eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung messbarer Geschäftswerte durch effektives Kategorie- und Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird eine starke Beschaffungsexpertise mit einem praktischen Ansatz kombinieren und in einem dynamischen Umfeld gedeihen, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Einfluss und Ausführung entscheidend für den Erfolg sind.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören

• Besitzen und verwalten Sie die Beschaffung in den Kategorien Allgemeine Dienstleistungen mit Rechenschaftspflicht für die Leistung und Ergebnisse der Kategorie.

• Analysieren Sie Ausgaben und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, Einsparungen, Wertschöpfung und Prozessverbesserungen voranzutreiben.

• Definieren und implementieren Sie Beschaffungsstrategien für Beschaffungsinitiativen in globalen, regionalen oder komplexen Bereichen.

• Führen Sie strategische Sourcing-Projekte von der Marktanalyse bis hin zur Lieferantenauswahl, Auftragsvergabe und Implementierung.

• Durchführung von Marktforschung, RFx-Prozessen, Ausschreibungsbewertungen und Lieferantenverhandlungen.

• Verhandeln Sie kaufmännische und vertragliche Bedingungen in Partnerschaft mit rechtlichen und wichtigen geschäftlichen Stakeholdern.

• Verwalten Sie hochkomplexe Beschaffungsprojekte und strategische Initiativen und gewährleisten Sie gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele.

• Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie Teammitglieder, setzen Sie klare Ziele und unterstützen Sie Leistung und Wachstum.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, einschließlich Digital, HR, Legal, Marketing, Kundenservice und anderen Geschäftsfunktionen.

• Verwalten Sie die Lieferantenbeziehungen, einschließlich Leistungsüberprüfungen, kommerzielle Gespräche, Vertragsverlängerungen, Eskalationen und Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

• Überwachen Sie Markttrends, Innovationen und neue Lösungen, um Chancen zu identifizieren, die Qualität, Nachhaltigkeit, Kosteneffizienz und Gesamtbetriebskosten verbessern.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Vertragsumsetzung und sorgen Sie für eine erfolgreiche Übernahme im gesamten Unternehmen.

• Beitrag zur Erreichung wichtiger Beschaffungsziele, einschließlich Einsparungen, Kategoriereife, Lieferantenoptimierung und Verbesserungen des Betriebskapitals.

• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserung und strategische Transformation innerhalb der Beschaffungsprozesse und Arbeitsweisen.

• Universitätsabschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.

• 7-8+ Jahre Category Management und strategische Sourcing Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung digitaler und/oder IT-Beschaffung und/oder anderer relevanter Kategorien für allgemeine Dienstleistungen

• Frühere Führungserfahrungen von Menschen, einschließlich Coaching und Entwicklung von Teams.

• Starkes Verhandlungsgeschick mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung von kommerziellem Wert.

• Hochanalytisch mit viel Liebe zum Detail und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Ausgaben- und Beschaffungsanalysen durchzuführen.

• Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen zu beeinflussen und zusammenzuarbeiten.

Avec votre équipe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'obtention d'une valeur commerciale mesurable grâce à une gestion efficace de la catégorie et des relations avec les fournisseurs. Le candidat retenu combinera une solide expertise en matière d'approvisionnement avec une approche pratique, prospère dans un environnement dynamique où la collaboration, l'influence et l'exécution sont essentielles au succès.

• Autoriser et gérer les achats dans les catégories des services généraux, en rendant compte du rendement et des résultats des catégories.

• Analyser les dépenses et identifier les occasions de générer des économies, de créer de la valeur et d'améliorer les processus.

• Négocier des termes commerciaux et contractuels en partenariat avec les intervenants juridiques et commerciaux clés.

• Gérer des projets d'approvisionnement et des initiatives stratégiques très complexes tout en assurant l'harmonisation avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Diriger, entraîner et développer les membres de l'équipe, fixer des objectifs clairs et soutenir la performance et la croissance.

• Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs, y compris les examens du rendement, les discussions commerciales, les renouvellements de contrats, les escalades et les initiatives d'amélioration continue.

• Surveiller les tendances du marché, les innovations et les solutions émergentes afin d'identifier les possibilités d'améliorer la qualité, la durabilité, le rapport coût-efficacité et le coût total de la propriété.

• Contribuer à la réalisation des principaux objectifs en matière d'approvisionnement, notamment les économies, la maturité des catégories, l'optimisation des fournisseurs et l'amélioration du fonds de roulement.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue et la transformation stratégique au sein des processus d'approvisionnement et des méthodes de travail.

À propos de toi

• Diplôme universitaire ou diplôme équivalent.

• 7-8 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de catégorie et en approvisionnement stratégique dans un environnement international.

• Expérience éprouvée en gestion des achats numériques et/ou informatiques et/ou d'autres services généraux pertinents

• Expérience de leadership de personnes antérieures, y compris l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes.

• Fortes compétences en négociation, avec un bilan de valeur commerciale.

• Très analytique avec une grande attention aux détails et la capacité d'effectuer des analyses complexes des dépenses et de l'approvisionnement.

• De solides compétences en gestion des intervenants avec la capacité d'influencer et de collaborer à plusieurs niveaux de fonctions et d'ancienneté.

• Un fonctionnement confortable dans des environnements commerciaux ambigus, rapides et en évolution.

• Proactive, pratique et axée sur la solution, avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation et de responsabilité.

• Joueur d'équipe collaborative avec des compétences d'écoute actives, empathie et un esprit de partenariat.

jobs.title: Manager FP&A Cocoa Sourcing
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Manager FP&A Cocoa Sourcing is a key member of the Global Cocoa Finance organization and is responsible for financial analysis, performance reporting, forecasting and valuation activities supporting Barry Callebaut (BC) Sourcing.

The role works closely with trading, logistics, risk management, accounting and finance teams to provide transparency on financial performance and support informed decision-making. Through exposure to commodity markets, derivatives, supply chain finance and international trade, the position offers a unique opportunity to develop deep finance expertise within one of the world’s leading cocoa sourcing organizations.

With increasing experience, the role is expected to take on broader responsibility for complex analyses, key finance processes, and the identification and implementation of continuous improvement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Owns the monthly financial closing and reporting activities for BC Sourcing

• Responsible for daily commodity valuation activities and weekly mark-to-market reporting

• Supports financial analysis related to trading performance and commodity market developments

• Supports forecasting and budgeting activities by providing reliable financial insights and recommendations

• Analyzes supply chain costs and operational performance drivers across the sourcing organization

• Translates complex financial information into clear and actionable insights for stakeholders for business partners and trading team

• Contributes to the broader Global Trading & Sourcing (GT&S) financial planning and performance management processes

• Continuously improves valuation methodologies, reporting quality and analytical tools

About You

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience

• 5–8 years of experience in FP&A, controlling, audit, transaction advisory, corporate finance or other analytical finance functions

• In depth understanding of derivatives finance and financial markets. Interest in commodity markets

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems

• Experience with Power BI, SQL, data analytics or programming would be an advantage

• Fluent English is required; additional languages are considered a plus

About the role

The Business Development Manager is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving and executing the premium powder growth agenda across the Central Eastern Europe and Middle East Africa region. This position identifies, develops, and secures high-value business opportunities in both existing and emerging markets, ensuring sustainable and profitable growth. Acting as a trusted thought partner to the Global Cocoa and Chocolate teams, the Business Development Manager plays a key role in shaping the region’s long-term growth strategy, strengthening market positioning, and translating strategic priorities into actionable business development initiatives aligned with Global Cocoa and broader Group objectives.

Key Responsibilities Include

Strategic Growth Leadership

• Define and execute premium powder growth agenda across the region (defining right product/customer mix with sales teams)

• Anticipate market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics, translating them into actionable strategies with cross-functions (R&D, QA, Supply Chain)

Business Continuity

• Coordinate powder activities across teams and regions, acting as a bridge between sales and internal stakeholders

• Develop a strong network of contacts within the Group - Customer Care, Marketing, Sourcing, Finance and Supply Chain - in order to support day to day business in the region and pro-actively supports the sales team, distributors & customers

• Lead cross-functional initiatives to penetrate high-potential customer segments and geographies (alignment with Chocolate)

Market Dynamics and Analysis

• Utilize data and other functional tools to research potential territories and markets, preparing reports with findings and recommendations

• Understanding regional dynamics and presenting comprehensive demand per sub-region annually are the essentials of the role (lead workshops on competition landscape, market sizing and consumption trends)

Best Practices Implementation:

• Build strong relationships with counterparts within Global Cocoa and Chocolate Regions and introduce best practices to the region from internal and external sources

About You

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Industrial & Food Engineering

• 10+ years in sales, business development or related commercial leadership roles, ideally within global or complex markets (experience in B2B, Food industry is preferred)

• Expertise in structuring and negotiating complex commercial agreements and partnerships

• Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical capability, and financial acumen

• Strong understanding of market dynamics and sales processes

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams

• Fluent in English; speaking French is preferred due to the region’s customer base or and any other language in the region

• Regular travel within region and to BC locations (Louviers, Hamburg, Zurich) required (on average 40% of work time)

• Strategic planning and execution

• Project management

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur de l'excellence commerciale - Gourmet Business

jobs.description:
About the Role

Reporting directly to the Director of Distribution Excellence you will play a relevant role in implementing our distribution and indirect channel model to the near future, deploying models and frameworks that will elevate our commercial performance in a global scale. This role requires accurate hands-on attitude, superior change management capabilities and enhanced experience on management of commercial activities and distribution framework in order to bring to life an effective and modern Distribution Excellence framework.

The main purpose of this role is to leverage our growth based on implementation of models and frameworks that will optimize and enhance our distribution network based on distribution strategic partnerships, supported by data-driven and performance-led collaborative program with our Distribution Partners, through enhanced data sharing and market visibility, improving collaboration, speed-to-market and business resilience. The Distribution Excellence Enablement Manager will act as the constructor of our Distribution programs.

Based on strong stakeholder management and strong entrepreneurship mindset, the implementation and development of a robust and pragmatic Strategic Distribution model will allow Barry Callebaut to deliver above the market growth based on end user and partner’s satisfaction and collaboration, shaping a successful model that will greatly support the activities of our Commercial teams around the globe.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Execute market research in order to build our Distribution Landscape assessment, including evaluation of the distribution footprint and reach and Delayered Distribution possibilities, looking for opportunities to drive growth, optimize efficiency and performance of our route to market and distribution network

• Distributor Capability Building – Define and deploy the sales excellence toolkits

• Pricing Governance – Ensure adoption of pricelist governance and track adherence

• Digital Ordering Capabilities – Enable distributors and drive adoption of Digital ordering capabilities deployed towards customers

• Develop comprehensive insights based on global and regional distribution landscape, identifying key trends, challenges, and opportunities to define our commercial background in different markets, mapping similarities and discrepancies

• Build a robust platform to strengthen strategic distributor engagement and training, enhancing capabilities and ensuring alignment with business goals

• Help to establish the global Distribution Excellence framework: Building clarity through the development of the details of the selected distribution models, synergizing channels, reducing channel conflicts, identifying resources needed as well as optimizing processes and aligning on interdependencies

• Support the implementation of the Commercial Intelligence insights model through the definition of relevant leading measures to drive growth and performance mainly aligned with the implementation of the systematic collection of the Secondary Sales Data (SSD) from our Strategic Partners

• Responsible for the interface with other departments (Digital, PMO and others) in order to build alignment in terms of project management, timelines and resources, aiming to leverage the positive impact of the Distribution Excellence framework

• Responsible for regular analysis of global and regional distribution performance, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement to drive continuous enhancement of our growth, distribution strategies and activation on the ground, based on Commercial Intelligence Analysis

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, or a related field

• Advanced degree - Master’s or MBA desired

• Proven track record on Commercial management roles or similar with experience on projects implementation

• Experience with Distribution Management highly desirable

• Project and Change Management experiences and stakeholder management skills will be considered as a plus

• Fluent in English, as it is the primary language of global business communication

• Additional language proficiency desirable

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Segnalando direttamente al Direttore di Eccellenza di Distribuzione Lei svolgerà un ruolo rilevante nell'attuazione del nostro modello di distribuzione e canale indiretto al prossimo futuro, implementando modelli e quadri che eleveranno le nostre prestazioni commerciali in scala globale. Questo ruolo richiede un atteggiamento preciso, capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti superiori e una maggiore esperienza nella gestione delle attività commerciali e del quadro di distribuzione al fine di portare a vita un quadro efficace e moderno di eccellenza di distribuzione.

Lo scopo principale di questo ruolo è quello di sfruttare la nostra crescita basata sull'implementazione di modelli e framework che ottimizzano e valorizzeranno la nostra rete di distribuzione basata su partnership strategiche di distribuzione, supportate da un programma collaborativo basato sui dati e sulle prestazioni con i nostri partner di distribuzione, attraverso una maggiore condivisione dei dati e visibilità del mercato, migliorando la collaborazione, la velocità al mercato e la resilienza aziendale. L'Eccellenza di distribuzione Enablement Manager fungerà da costruttore dei nostri programmi di distribuzione.

Sulla base di una forte gestione degli stakeholder e di una forte mentalità imprenditoriale, l’implementazione e lo sviluppo di un modello di distribuzione strategica robusto e pragmatico permetterà a Barry Callebaut di offrire al di sopra della crescita del mercato basata sulla soddisfazione e sulla collaborazione dell’utente finale e del partner, modellando un modello di successo che sosterrà notevolmente le attività dei nostri team commerciali in tutto il mondo.

Responsabilità chiave

• Eseguire la ricerca di mercato al fine di costruire la nostra valutazione del paesaggio di distribuzione, compresa la valutazione dell'impronta di distribuzione e raggiungere e le possibilità di distribuzione delayered, alla ricerca di opportunità per guidare la crescita, ottimizzare l'efficienza e le prestazioni del nostro percorso per il mercato e la rete di distribuzione

• Distributore Capability Building – Definire e distribuire i toolkit di eccellenza di vendita

• Governance dei prezzi – Assicurare l'adozione della governance dei listino prezzi e l'adesione della pista

• Capacità di ordinazione digitale – Abilita distributori e aziona l'adozione di capacità di ordinazione digitale implementate verso i clienti

• Sviluppare approfondimenti basati sul paesaggio di distribuzione globale e regionale, identificare tendenze chiave, sfide e opportunità per definire il nostro background commerciale in diversi mercati, mappare somiglianze e discrepanze

• Costruire una piattaforma robusta per rafforzare il coinvolgimento e la formazione dei distributori strategici, migliorare le capacità e garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali

• Aiuta a stabilire il quadro globale di Eccellenza di Distribuzione: costruire chiarezza attraverso lo sviluppo dei dettagli dei modelli di distribuzione selezionati, canali sinergizzanti, ridurre i conflitti dei canali, identificare le risorse necessarie, nonché ottimizzare i processi e allineare le interdipendenze

• Sostenere l'implementazione del modello di insight dell'Intelligence Commerciale attraverso la definizione di misure rilevanti per guidare la crescita e le prestazioni principalmente allineate all'implementazione della raccolta sistematica dei Dati di Vendite Secondari (SSD) dai nostri partner strategici

• Responsabile per l'interfaccia con altri dipartimenti (Digital, PMO e altri) al fine di costruire allineamento in termini di gestione del progetto, tempi e risorse, al fine di sfruttare l'impatto positivo del quadro di Eccellenza di distribuzione

• Responsabile per l'analisi periodica delle prestazioni di distribuzione globali e regionali, l'individuazione di tendenze, opportunità e aree di miglioramento per promuovere il miglioramento continuo della nostra crescita, strategie di distribuzione e attivazione sul terreno, basato sull'analisi dell'intelligenza commerciale

A proposito di te

• Corso di laurea in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing o un campo relativo

• Grado avanzato - Master o MBA desiderato

• Provato record su ruoli di gestione commerciale o simile con esperienza sull'implementazione dei progetti

• Esperienza con Gestione della distribuzione altamente auspicabile

• Le esperienze di Project and Change Management e le competenze di gestione degli stakeholder saranno considerate come un plus

• Fluente in inglese, in quanto è la lingua principale della comunicazione aziendale globale

• Ulteriori competenze linguistiche auspicabili

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Rolle

Wenn Sie direkt an den Director of Distribution Excellence berichten, werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Implementierung unseres Vertriebs- und indirekten Kanalmodells für die nahe Zukunft spielen und Modelle und Frameworks einsetzen, die unsere kommerzielle Leistung auf globaler Ebene steigern werden. Diese Rolle erfordert eine genaue praktische Einstellung, überlegene Change-Management-Fähigkeiten und erweiterte Erfahrung im Management von kommerziellen Aktivitäten und Vertriebsrahmen, um ein effektives und modernes Distribution Excellence-Rahmenwerk zum Leben zu erwecken.

Der Hauptzweck dieser Rolle ist es, unser Wachstum auf der Grundlage der Implementierung von Modellen und Frameworks zu nutzen, die unser Vertriebsnetzwerk auf der Grundlage strategischer Vertriebspartnerschaften optimieren und verbessern, unterstützt durch datengesteuertes und leistungsorientiertes Kooperationsprogramm mit unseren Vertriebspartnern, durch verbesserten Datenaustausch und Markttransparenz, Verbesserung der Zusammenarbeit, der Geschwindigkeit bis zur Markteinführung und der Geschäftsresilienz. Der Distribution Excellence Enablement Manager fungiert als Konstrukteur unserer Distributionsprogramme.

Basierend auf einem starken Stakeholder-Management und einer starken unternehmerischen Denkweise wird die Implementierung und Entwicklung eines robusten und pragmatischen strategischen Vertriebsmodells es Barry Callebaut ermöglichen, auf der Grundlage der Zufriedenheit und Zusammenarbeit von Endbenutzern und Partnern über dem Marktwachstum zu liegen und ein erfolgreiches Modell zu entwickeln, das die Aktivitäten unserer kaufmännischen Teams auf der ganzen Welt stark unterstützen wird.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören

• Führen Sie Marktforschung durch, um unsere Distribution Landscape-Bewertung zu erstellen, einschließlich der Bewertung des Distributions-Fußabdrucks und der Reichweite sowie der Delayered Distribution-Möglichkeiten, und suchen Sie nach Möglichkeiten, um das Wachstum voranzutreiben, die Effizienz und Leistung unserer Route zum Markt und Vertriebsnetz zu optimieren.

• Distributor Capability Building – Definieren und implementieren Sie die Sales Excellence Toolkits

• Pricing Governance – Sicherstellen der Übernahme von Preislisten-Governance und Track-Compliance

• Digitale Bestellfunktionen - Ermöglichen Sie Distributoren und fördern Sie die Einführung digitaler Bestellfunktionen, die für Kunden bereitgestellt werden

• Entwickeln Sie umfassende Erkenntnisse auf der Grundlage der globalen und regionalen Vertriebslandschaft, identifizieren Sie wichtige Trends, Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, um unseren kommerziellen Hintergrund in verschiedenen Märkten zu definieren, und kartieren Sie Ähnlichkeiten und Diskrepanzen

• Aufbau einer robusten Plattform zur Stärkung des strategischen Vertriebspartner-Engagements und -Trainings, Verbesserung der Fähigkeiten und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele

• Helfen Sie dabei, das globale Distribution Excellence Framework zu etablieren: Klarheit schaffen durch die Entwicklung der Details der ausgewählten Verteilungsmodelle, Synergien von Kanälen, Reduzierung von Kanalkonflikten, Identifizierung von benötigten Ressourcen sowie Optimierung von Prozessen und Ausrichtung auf Interdependenzen

• Unterstützung der Implementierung des Commercial Intelligence Insights-Modells durch die Definition relevanter Leitmaßnahmen zur Förderung von Wachstum und Leistung, die hauptsächlich auf die Implementierung der systematischen Erhebung der Secondary Sales Data (SSD) von unseren strategischen Partnern ausgerichtet sind

• Verantwortlich für die Schnittstelle zu anderen Abteilungen (Digital, PMO und andere), um eine Ausrichtung in Bezug auf Projektmanagement, Zeitpläne und Ressourcen zu erreichen und die positiven Auswirkungen des Distribution Excellence-Frameworks zu nutzen

• Verantwortlich für die regelmäßige Analyse der globalen und regionalen Vertriebsleistung, Identifizierung von Trends, Chancen und Verbesserungsbereichen, um die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unseres Wachstums, unserer Vertriebsstrategien und Aktivierung vor Ort auf der Grundlage der Commercial Intelligence Analyse voranzutreiben.

Über dich

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Erweiterter Abschluss - Master oder MBA gewünscht

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei kaufmännischen Managementrollen oder ähnlichem mit Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung von Projekten

• Erfahrung mit Distribution Management sehr wünschenswert

• Projekt- und Change-Management-Erfahrungen und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten werden als Plus angesehen

• fließend Englisch, da es die Hauptsprache der globalen Geschäftskommunikation ist

• Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse wünschenswert
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos du rôle

Relevant directement du directeur de l'excellence en distribution, vous jouerez un rôle pertinent dans la mise en œuvre de notre modèle de distribution et de canal indirect dans un avenir proche, en déployant des modèles et des cadres qui amélioreront notre performance commerciale à l'échelle mondiale. Ce rôle exige une attitude pratique précise, des capacités supérieures de gestion du changement et une expérience accrue de la gestion des activités commerciales et du cadre de distribution afin de mettre en place un cadre d'excellence en matière de distribution efficace et moderne.

Le but principal de ce rôle est de tirer parti de notre croissance basée sur la mise en oeuvre de modèles et de cadres qui optimiseront et amélioreront notre réseau de distribution basé sur des partenariats stratégiques de distribution, appuyés par un programme de collaboration axé sur les données et le rendement avec nos partenaires de distribution, grâce à un meilleur partage de données et à une meilleure visibilité du marché, à une meilleure collaboration, à une plus grande rapidité de commercialisation et à une plus grande résilience des entreprises. Le gestionnaire de l'excellence en distribution agira comme constructeur de nos programmes de distribution.

Basée sur une gestion forte des intervenants et une solide mentalité entrepreneuriale, la mise en œuvre et le développement d'un modèle de distribution stratégique robuste et pragmatique permettront à Barry Callebaut de dépasser la croissance du marché basée sur la satisfaction et la collaboration de l'utilisateur final et du partenaire, façonnant un modèle réussi qui soutiendra grandement les activités de nos équipes commerciales partout dans le monde.

Principales responsabilités

• Exécuter des études de marché afin de construire notre évaluation du paysage de distribution, y compris l'évaluation de l'empreinte de distribution et des possibilités de distribution retardée, à la recherche d'opportunités pour stimuler la croissance, optimiser l'efficacité et la performance de notre route vers le marché et le réseau de distribution

• Renforcement des capacités des distributeurs – Définir et déployer les outils d'excellence commerciale

• Gouvernance des prix – Assurer l'adoption de la gouvernance des listes de prix et suivre l'adhésion

• Capacités de commande numérique – Permettre aux distributeurs et favoriser l'adoption des capacités de commande numérique déployées auprès des clients

• Mettre au point des perspectives globales fondées sur le paysage mondial et régional de la distribution, en identifiant les principales tendances, les défis et les possibilités pour définir notre contexte commercial sur différents marchés, cartographier les similitudes et les écarts

• Bâtir une plateforme solide pour renforcer l'engagement et la formation des distributeurs stratégiques, renforcer les capacités et assurer l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels

• Aider à établir le cadre mondial d'excellence en matière de distribution : clarifier les détails des modèles de distribution sélectionnés, synerger les canaux, réduire les conflits de canaux, identifier les ressources nécessaires et optimiser les processus et s'aligner sur les interdépendances

• Soutenir la mise en œuvre du modèle d'information commerciale par la définition de mesures de pointe pertinentes pour stimuler la croissance et la performance, principalement alignée sur la mise en œuvre de la collecte systématique des données secondaires sur les ventes (SSD) auprès de nos partenaires stratégiques

• Responsable de l'interface avec d'autres ministères (Digital, PMO et autres) afin d'harmoniser la gestion de projet, les échéanciers et les ressources, en vue de tirer parti de l'impact positif du cadre d'excellence en distribution

• Responsable de l'analyse régulière de la performance de la distribution mondiale et régionale, de l'identification des tendances, des possibilités et des domaines d'amélioration pour favoriser l'amélioration continue de nos stratégies de croissance, de distribution et d'activation sur le terrain, basée sur l'analyse du renseignement commercial

À propos de toi

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, marketing ou un domaine connexe

• Diplôme avancé - Masters ou MBA souhaité

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de rôles de gestion commerciale ou d'expérience similaire en matière de mise en oeuvre de projets

• Expérience de la gestion de la distribution hautement souhaitable

• Les expériences en gestion de projet et de changement et les compétences en gestion des intervenants seront considérées comme un plus

• Fluent en anglais, car c'est la langue principale de la communication globale des entreprises

• Compétences linguistiques supplémentaires souhaitables

jobs.title: Global Brand Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Global Brand to drive the global growth and brand activation of Cacao Barry across international markets while acting as the steward of the Callebaut Masters of Taste brand platform. As a senior individual contributor, you will translate brand strategy into impactful campaigns, sales enablement tools, activation frameworks, and brand governance programs that support commercial growth and brand consistency across more than 50 markets.

In this highly cross-functional role, you will collaborate closely with Marketing, Commercial, Regional teams, R&D, Digital, Finance, Corporate Communications, and external partners to ensure successful brand deployment, market activation, and performance tracking. You will play a key role in strengthening Cacao Barry’s premium positioning while enabling commercial teams and distributors to bring the brand to life through compelling customer experiences and world-class brand execution.

The role is a maternity cover between 01/09/2026 - 31/01/2027.

Key Responsibilities include

• Define and execute the global growth strategy and activation roadmap for Cacao Barry across international markets, ensuring clear positioning and differentiation.

• Develop and maintain a “global backbone, local relevance” framework, providing brand guidelines and guardrails that ensure consistency while enabling market adaptation.

• Lead portfolio architecture and go-to-market support by market, including SKU prioritization, portfolio pathways, and channel-specific brand support models.

• Create and maintain sales enablement tools, including commercial presentations, distributor materials, objection-handling guides, and value proposition frameworks.

• Translate brand strengths and innovations into compelling audience-specific messaging for pastry chefs, chocolatiers, artisan professionals, distributors, and HoReCa customers.

• Partner with regional commercial teams and distributors to drive market activation initiatives, training programs, workshops, trade shows, and customer engagement activities in priority markets.

• Lead the end-to-end development and execution of global marketing campaigns, ensuring consistency across digital and offline channels while adapting content to local market needs.

• Design and deliver training programs that equip commercial, regional, and distributor teams with the knowledge and tools needed to successfully activate brands in market.

• Own performance tracking and reporting, developing dashboards and insights that measure business impact, brand adoption, and commercial effectiveness.

• Act as the guardian of the Masters of Taste brand platform, maintaining key brand assets, guidelines, and governance processes across the organization.

• Build and manage brand knowledge resources, review regional brand executions, and continuously improve tools, guidance, and best practices to strengthen global brand consistency and adoption.

About You

• 7–10 years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing Strategy, or Commercial Marketing, with a meaningful portion in B2B and/or premium food or ingredients sectors. Chocolate or fine food industry experience is a plus.

• Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Brand Management, or equivalent; or bachelor’s with commensurate professional experience.

• Proven track record of owning brand strategy workstreams end-to-end and translating them into tangible deliverables (toolkits, campaign frameworks, guidelines).

• Experience building sales enablement tools: decks, playbooks, objection-handling guides, distributor materials.

• Comfortable managing concurrent workstreams across different geographies and timelines, with limited direct support.

• Experience working in or with cross-functional, matrixed, international organizations — influencing without authority.

• Exposure to corporate brand management and/or brand governance is a plus (alongside portfolio or product brand experience).

• Fluent English required (written and verbal). French is a strong plus

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Manager, Global Brand per guidare la crescita globale e l'attivazione del marchio di Cacao Barry attraverso i mercati internazionali, mentre agisce come amministratore della piattaforma del marchio Callebaut Masters of Taste. Come contributore individuale senior, tradurrai la strategia del marchio in campagne d'impatto, strumenti di abilitazione delle vendite, framework di attivazione e programmi di governance del marchio che supportano la crescita commerciale e la coerenza del marchio in oltre 50 mercati.

In questo ruolo altamente interfunzionale, collaborerai a stretto contatto con Marketing, Commercial, Regional team, R&D, Digital, Finance, Corporate Communications e partner esterni per garantire un successo di distribuzione del marchio, attivazione del mercato e monitoraggio delle prestazioni. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rafforzare il posizionamento premium di Cacao Barry, consentendo a team commerciali e distributori di portare il marchio alla vita attraverso esperienze di cliente convincenti e l'esecuzione di marca di livello mondiale.

Il ruolo è una copertura di maternità tra 01/09/2026 - 31/01/2027.

Le responsabilità chiave includono

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di crescita globale e la roadmap di attivazione per Cacao Barry in tutti i mercati internazionali, garantendo un posizionamento e una differenziazione chiari.

• Sviluppare e mantenere un quadro “global backbone, rilevanza locale”, fornendo linee guida e guardrails di marca che garantiscono coerenza, consentendo l’adattamento del mercato.

• Architettura del portafoglio di piombo e supporto go-to-market per mercato, tra cui priorità SKU, percorsi di portafoglio e modelli di supporto del marchio specifiche canale.

• Creare e mantenere strumenti di abilitazione delle vendite, tra cui presentazioni commerciali, materiali di distribuzione, guide di gestione delle obiezioni e framework di proposizione del valore.

About You

• 7–10 years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing Strategy, or Commercial Marketing, with a meaningful portion in B2B and/or premium food or ingredients sectors. Chocolate or fine food industry experience is a plus.

Barry Callebaut’s future relies on strengthening customer trust while navigating shifting markets and rapid technological change. As part of one of three Global CX Centers of Excellence, the Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties shapes and drives the global Commercial Excellence agenda for the Food Manufacturers segment and Specialties category, in close partnership with regional Sales, Marketing, R&D, Chocolate Academy, and Operations.

The role ensures that commercial teams continuously improve Customer Experience across the entire Customer Journey.

• Embed Commercial Excellence through Salesforce adoption, including playbooks, dashboards, and account planning

• Strengthen Strategic Account Planning for FM, Retail & Chains with clear governance and adoption tracking

• Activate Winning Portfolio with customers by partnering closely with Marketing and enabling commercial teams

• Enhance Pricing Excellence by supporting strategic pricing initiatives and improving end‑to‑end pricing processes

• Improve Master Data & Systems to streamline internal workflows and elevate customer experience

• Advance Pricing Maturity through the Next Level Pricing initiative, improving contract pricing, quotation experience, and value‑in‑use monetization

• Develop Commercial Excellence Academy content in collaboration with the CX Learning team

• Lead Global Content Exchange for FM, Retail & Chains, ensuring consistent updates on innovation, sustainability, quality, and services

• Identify Global Big Bets using Commercial Intelligence and drive corrective actions to support growth

• Provide Targeted Support to Chains and Retail segments as needed

• Demonstrated ability to deliver through cross‑functional collaboration, working effectively across diverse teams and organizational levels

À propos du rôle Barry Callebaut s'appuie sur le renforcement de la confiance des clients tout en naviguant sur des marchés changeants et des changements technologiques rapides. Pour y parvenir, nous aiguisons une ambition d'expérience client unifiée (CX) qui nous pousse au-delà d'un état d'esprit de marchandise et nous positionne en tant que conseiller de confiance de nos clients. Dans le cadre de l'un des trois Global CX Centers of Excellence, le Commercial Excellence Manager - Food Manufacturers & Specialties façonne et pilote le programme mondial d'excellence commerciale pour le segment et les spécialités des fabricants d'aliments, en partenariat étroit avec les ventes régionales, le marketing, la R-D, Chocolate Academy et les opérations.
